scheme_name: Scheme of Extending Financial Assistance to New Drama Productions
other_conditions: The drama must reflect Tamil art forms, culture, civilization, tradition, society and history
The drama must not have been staged previously
The drama must not display caste, religious, or political animosity
No additional dialogues or scenes may be added without prior approval of the Manram
Drama scripts must be selected by the Manram
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹20,000 per drama, paid in four installments based on quality and staging criteria.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
